AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Wild Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Fruits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
